newsitem.title: USA: Ontario Hydro 540 MW nuke unit to restart Sept 23.
newsitem.headline: Ontario Hydro 540 MW nuke unit to restart Sept 23.

text.p: A 540 megawatt (MW) nuclear power unit at the Ontario Hydro Pickering, Ont., power plant is expected to resume output on Sept 23, a company spokesman said Monday.
The unit will be the fifth 540 MW unit at the eight-unit Pickering station to resume output over the past several months.
All units at the station were shut April 20 due to a problem with a backup valve on an emergency coolant system.
A sixth unit is scheduled to resume operations Oct 16, said company spokesman Ted Gruetzner.
No startup date has yet been set for the remaining two units, the spokesman said.
The Pickering plant represents about 19 percent of Ontario Hydro's total 33,000 MW generating capacity.
Pickering is located east of Toronto, Ontario.
The four Pickering units which resumed operations through the summer were operating normally at 100 percent capacity, Gruetzner said.
A 930 MW unit at the Darlington, Ont. power station, also east of Toronto, was set to resume power output on Sept 23 after shutting down for scheduled maintenance on Aug 23, the spokesman said.
The remaining three 930 MW units at Darlington were operating normally, he said.
